about: Models picked from free (CC0) packs downloaded by hand from Kenney (kenney.nl) and Quaternius (quaternius.com), imported into the project library by `python -m fyt kit --picks DIR` (fyt/packs.py), DIR holding the pack zips. Each pick: the zip's name (as downloaded; a Google Drive download is named by the pack's own licence file instead), the model's file name without extension, the library key, and the words a story uses for it (whole words with '='), and optionally what else to record (`in`: the folder of the pack to take it from; `clips`: the only animations kept; a person's `sex` and the `roles` their outfit suits, for fyt/people.py). The first pick whose words a story's entity uses is the one shown, so the specific come before the general.

voxel-vehicles.source: supplied by the channel owner (a voxel vehicle pack)
